mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM weight_records WHERE ORDER BY measured_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM weight_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM weight_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND measured_at >= #{start} AND measured_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND source_name=#{source} ORDER BY measured_at DESC,id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE weight_records SET measured_at=#{measuredAt},weight_kg=#{weightKg}, note=#{note},corrected=TRUE,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM weight_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT source_name FROM weight_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY source_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weight_goals(user_id,start_date,target_date,target_weight_kg,source_name) VALUES(#{userId},#{startDate},#{targetDate},#{targetWeightKg},#{sourceName}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_date=VALUES(start_date),target_date=VALUES(target_date), target_weight_kg=VALUES(target_weight_kg),source_name=VALUES(source_name),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
